_readme: Every fixed value an application form asks for. Copy to config/profile.json (gitignored). Used VERBATIM; the agent never guesses. An empty value that a form requires becomes NEEDS_HUMAN, not an invented answer. Tailored resume content comes from references/master.tex; work_history / education_entries / skills_list mirror it for structured forms (Workday). Add your own keys freely.
_name_note: first_name / preferred_first_name for generic name fields; legal_full_name only where the field explicitly says legal.
_school_note: school_picker_name = how the school appears in Greenhouse/Ashby school dropdowns, e.g. 'University of Example, Main Campus'.
gpa_rule: Fill GPA only when the field is required.
_transcript_note: Absolute or repo-relative path to an unofficial transcript PDF. Empty = a form that requires one is NEEDS_HUMAN.
_legal_note: Exactly as you would answer on a form, e.g. 'Yes' / 'No' / 'U.S. citizen'. Legal questions are answered ONLY from these keys.
desired_comp_answer: I am open to the posted range for this role and would rather align on level first.
_comp_note: Never let the agent invent a salary number. Replace the sentence with a real number only if you have one.
_previously_note: Companies you have worked at (for 'have you worked for X before?'). Everything else gets No.
_consent_note: Applies to consent/acknowledgement questions only (privacy policy, background check, interview recording, SMS contact). Never to questions of fact.

eeo.veteran: I am not a protected veteran
eeo.disability: I do not want to answer

_eeo_note: Fill these yourself. The agent never infers any of them.
_email_note: email is used on every form; personal_email only when a form rejects .edu addresses or asks for a personal email.
_graduation_ms_note: Optional later (graduate) degree date. Forms use it only when the tailored resume includes that degree.

work_history.title: Software Engineer Intern
work_history.description: One paragraph built from every bullet for this role in master.tex, without bullet markers.

_work_history_note: Structured work history for multi-step forms (Workday My Experience). Every role from master.tex, newest first. Optional `conditional`: when to leave an entry out.
_skills_note: Every skill from master.tex's Technical Skills section, most important first. Forms that cap or reject long skill lists keep the earliest ones.
